events.title: Stanford vs Berkeley: The Big Hack Game
events.description: Two kickoff hubs on November 15. Pick the one on your campus, no travel needed: Stanford students at Stanford campus, Berkeley students at Cal Alumni House, UC Berkeley.

events.title: GTM Breakthrough Summit | $25K Founder Opportunity
events.description: Land your first 100 customers with GTM leaders from Workday, Clay, Blitzscaling Ventures, Virio, Resemble AI, Teleport and Imprezia (YC S25).

events.title: Lean-Transfer Fall 2026 Demo Day
events.location: Chou Hall, Room N170, Berkeley Haas
events.description: Where deep tech meets market impact. Lean-Transfer is a Berkeley Haas course in which teams of MBA, engineering and science graduate students use Lean Launchpad methods to test the commercial potential of inventions from UC Berkeley, UCSF, Berkeley Lab, Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA.

events.title: UC LAUNCH Demo Day
events.location: Spieker Forum in Chou Hall at the Haas School of Business
events.description: Join us on May 6th at UC Berkeley Haas School of Business for UC LAUNCH Demo Day, where top startups from across the UC system pitch, compete for $50K+ in prizes, and connect with founders, investors, and innovators.

events.title: UC LAUNCH Accelerator Demo Day: Fall 2026
events.location: Spieker Forum, Chou Hall (6th floor), Berkeley Haas, 2220 Piedmont Ave
events.description: UC LAUNCH Demo Day is the finale of the Fall 2026 UC LAUNCH Accelerator, the zero-equity accelerator for founders from across the University of California. Finalist teams pitch for $50K+ in prizes, and the audience votes for a $1,000 Audience Choice Award.

events.title: NEWTON LIVE: Freada Kapor Klein & Mitch Kapor at UC Berkeley
events.description: Join us for a special livestream with Freada Kapor Klein and Mitch Kapor, part of the A. Richard Newton Lecture Series. The Kapors are co-founders of the Kapor Center and Kapor Capital and co-authors of Closing the Equity Gap.
